title: Check Out Taylor Swift’s Performance at ‘The 60th Annual CMA Awards’
summary: Taylor Swift makes her return to the CMA Awards, listen live from Nashville's Bridgestone Arena on SiriusXM.
body_markdown:
[Taylor Swift](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/taylor-swift) makes her return to the CMA Awards for the first time in 13 years to perform a mashup of “Our Song” and “I Knew It, I Knew You,” live from Nashville’s Bridgestone Arena.


[CMA Awards Radio Taylor Swift’s Performance Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTaylorSwiftCMAAwards)


### Listen to Taylor Swift’s Performance at the 60th Annual CMA Awards


Tune in to[CMA Awards Radio](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/cma-awards-radio-listen-live) on The Highway (Ch. 56) on satellite radio and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTaylorSwiftCMAAwards) through Thursday, November 19.


### Watch “The 60th Annual CMA Awards” on ABC and Disney+


**Live November 18 at 8/7c on ABC and Disney+ (next day on Hulu).**


For more information about “The 60th Annual CMA Awards,” visit[CMAawards.com](https://cmaawards.com/) .
